whoWeAre.title: Welcome to
whoWeAre.p1: The Palestinian Civil Entity for Environment, Development & Enhancement (PCED) is an independent, licensed, and accredited Palestinian non-governmental organization, founded in 2023 by an elite group of academic, scientific, and technical professionals. The entity strives to contribute effectively to achieving sustainable development in Palestine.
whoWeAre.p2: Through environmental protection, developing pioneering environmental and developmental policies and programs, with a focus on community empowerment and strengthening partnerships locally and internationally. We believe that the sustainability of our resources is the key to our generations' future.
goals.title: Our Strategic Goals
goals.subtitle: We work with a clear vision aimed at advancing the environmental and developmental reality in Palestinian society through integrated areas of work
goals.1.name: Enhancing Environmental & Climate Awareness
goals.1.desc: Spreading a culture of environmental preservation and addressing climate challenges through comprehensive awareness programs targeting all segments of society.
goals.2.name: Developing Sustainable Programs
goals.2.desc: Working on practical initiatives that improve environmental quality and support sustainability, in partnership with governmental and civil institutions.
goals.3.name: Community Development
goals.3.desc: Implementing development projects that consider environmental, economic, and social dimensions to ensure balance and justice.
goals.4.name: Youth Empowerment
goals.4.desc: Developing the skills of the new generation and equipping them with the necessary capabilities to be an active part of development and building processes.
goals.5.name: International Cooperation
goals.5.desc: Establishing strategic relationships and partnerships with international environmental and developmental organizations, and exchanging global expertise.
goals.6.name: Supporting Community Participation
goals.6.desc: Engaging civil society and vulnerable groups in environmental protection efforts to ensure long-term positive impact.
quote.text: "We are committed to spreading environmental awareness and combating climate change to create a healthy environment for current and future generations."

activitiesPage.desc: At the Palestinian Center for Environmental Development, we believe that resilience begins with empowering the community. Our programs include urgent and sustainable interventions to strengthen our people's ability to face environmental and social challenges through thoughtful development and direct support.

research.heroDesc: At the Palestinian Center for Environmental Development, we are committed to providing a robust scientific database that supports biodiversity conservation and sustainable development efforts in Palestine. Our research bridges traditional inherited knowledge and modern technologies.
research.dbDesc: We are currently updating the research and scientific studies database to provide the best knowledge resources. The updated version will be launched soon to include field reports, academic studies, and specialized environmental policy papers.
